valuation.valuation_commentary: Cash flow-based intrinsic anchors (Unlevered DCF at $45.99, Levered DCF at $50.14, Self-built DCF at $63.24, and Owner Earnings at $46.80) reflect a severe intrinsic valuation gap (-85.37% DCF gap) against the current price of $432.185, pricing in an aggressive 5-year FCF CAGR of 60%. In contrast, the sell-side consensus PT of $461.50 reflects high market optimism around AI-driven ATE compute testing and advanced packaging demand. Forward revenue validation confirmed that while the top-line trajectory is supported, the valuation remains stretched, softening the initial severe penalty to -1.0. The resulting weighted fair value of $254.78 (-41.05% vs current price) places TER firmly in the extreme_overvalued verdict band.
